error_message: rank.test: 23×17 expected 'difference-of-squares' top, got 'place-value-split' (three-way tie at 4.75)
root_cause: Cost model charged 400−9 two borrow penalties, but subtracting a single digit from a round number is trivial mentally; also round-down-compensate produced a tree identical to place-value-split, inflating the tie.
fix: Skip borrow penalty when subtrahend ≤ 10 in cost.ts; dedupe identical step trees (by joined step exprs) in rank.ts after sorting.

error_message: TS2345 in leftToRight.ts: Type '"square"' is not assignable to type 'StepOp' (passing Problem.op where StepOp expected)
root_cause: Problem['op'] ('add'|'sub'|'mul'|'div'|'square'|'pct') is wider than StepOp; applies() narrows to add/sub at runtime but TS can't see it inside expand().
fix: Compute `adding = p.op === 'add'` once and pass the literal 'add'/'sub' to step().
